## Goal
- Complete secure OTP/member-authentication repair, canonical reconciliation, deployment, and SHA-matched production certification for `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Complete work line-by-line without jumping between unrelated tasks.
- Use only canonical repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Never expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal identities.
- Diagnose GitHub `401` before changing authentication; use approved owner/GitHub App credentials with minimum permissions.
- Preserve local code; do not reset, overwrite, or delete approved work without explicit authorization.
- Create a recovery branch and backup tag before canonical-history reconciliation.
- Do not deploy until OTP plaintext persistence is eliminated and focused OTP tests pass.
- Do not certify production without independently verifiable SHA-matched GitHub, Actions, Render, and live evidence.
- Final acceptance requires `GitHub HEAD = Actions source SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA`.
- If proof remains unavailable, final output must start `PRODUCTION NOT YET VERIFIED` and contain only missing proof, blocker, required owner action, and next step.
- Do not paste a GitHub token into chat; use an approved private secret mechanism.

## Progress
### Done
- Rechecked live endpoints:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version → 200
  ```
- Live deployment reports:
  ```text
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  ```
- Rechecked configured GitHub authentication:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user → HTTP 401
  ```
- Root dependencies restored:
  ```text
  bun install --frozen-lockfile
  261 packages installed
  ```
- Local OTP hardening applied in `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`:
  - Deployment marker:
    ```ts
    'ivx-member-verification-v4-secure-persistence'
    ```
  - Added `RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS = 60_000`.
  - Filesystem persistence fallback is blocked when:
    ```ts
    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
    ```
  - Production without durable storage throws:
    ```text
    Secure verification storage is unavailable.
    ```
  - Added `pruneExpiredCodes()` for verified/expired fallback records.
  - Resend flow prunes before storage, enforces cooldown, and retains resend cap.
  - OTP logs no longer expose user IDs, verification type, code-storage details, or primary-store exception details.
- Completed bearer-session binding in `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`:
  - Member handlers call:
    ```ts
    await requireAuthenticatedMember(request)
    ```
  - Caller-provided `userId` no longer selects the member account.
  - Missing/invalid auth returns HTTP `401` with:
    ```text
    Authentication required.
    ```
  - Removed residual `getAuthUserId(request)` references, including `handleStartKYC`.
  - Canonical email/SMS verification sync failures emit generic warnings without exception details.
- Validation passed:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
  ```
  - Targeted suite: **38 passed, 0 failed**.
- `functions.runChecks` found no registered Expo/React Native app at workspace root:
  ```text
  runChecks has no app to check — this workspace has no React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Web, Supabase, or Cloudflare app yet.
  ```
- Performed Render/GitHub-token QA without exposing credentials:
  ```text
  render_api_key=missing
  workspace_github_token_present=false
  ```
- Recorded Render GitHub-token QA in:
  ```text
  .rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md
  ```

### In Progress
- Add focused member-verification/OTP endpoint security tests:
  - invalid/missing bearer rejection;
  - body `userId` cannot act on another account;
  - hash-only storage;
  - expiry, single-use, bounded attempts/resends;
  - cooldown, cleanup, redaction;
  - production durable-store failure behavior.
- Update OTP service header comments to clarify production fail-closed persistence behavior.
- Audit primary AI configuration/provider selection, timeout/retry behavior, persistence, and safe telemetry.
- Inventory local commits and uncommitted changes before recovery branch/tag or canonical reconciliation.

### Blocked
- Canonical GitHub authentication remains unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user → HTTP 401
  ```
- `gh` CLI remains unavailable:
  ```text
  sh: 1: gh: not found
  ```
- No `RENDER_API_KEY` is available in this workspace, so Render service environment variables cannot be inspected or exercised:
  ```text
  render_api_key=missing
  ```
- No workspace `GITHUB_TOKEN` is available:
  ```text
  workspace_github_token_present=false
  ```
- Render-side explicit `GITHUB_TOKEN` existence and validity are unverified; previous GitHub credential evidence was HTTP `401`.
- Canonical repository identity, commits, pull requests, Actions, workflow/job results, branch protection, and required review cannot be verified.
- Current `origin` is a Rork router rather than direct canonical GitHub:
  ```text
  https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- No approved authenticated member or owner production session is available for registration, OTP, sign-in/reset/session, owner-route, or Supabase-record verification.
- Live SHA `012bb088...` is not proven to contain local OTP and member-authentication changes.
- Mobile/web E2E, Android emulator, iOS approved-environment tests, release builds, and SHA-matched installation proof remain unexecuted.
- OTP schema comments identify a missing production prerequisite:
  ```text
  schema repair requires the service-role key, which is not configured
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Finish OTP/member-authentication repair and validate it before AI, Git, Render, or release work.
- Member verification, profile, KYC, and related actions must bind to cryptographically verified bearer-token user identity, not request-body/query `userId`.
- Do not retain filesystem OTP persistence as a production fallback; require durable configured storage or fail closed.
- Treat `/health` and `/version` only as proof of deployed SHA `012bb088...`, not GitHub/CI/Render provenance.
- Preserve top-level and nested checkout state until canonical access is restored and recovery artifacts are created.
- Do not certify public chat while production returns:
  ```json
  {"source":"fallback"}
  ```
- Distinguish Render’s GitHub integration from an explicit Render `GITHUB_TOKEN`:
  - GitHub integration lets Render pull/build the authorized repository and branch.
  - It does not prove the running service has an API token or that such token is valid.
  - Render does not automatically distribute source code or credentials to external services; the deployed backend accesses each service only through explicitly configured credentials and code.

## Next Steps
- 1. Add and run focused member-verification/OTP endpoint security tests.
- 2. Update `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` header documentation for production fail-closed persistence.
- 3. Run broader root/backend and Expo lint/type/test checks; capture, repair, and rerun failures.
- 4. Audit AI provider configuration, primary/fallback behavior, timeout/retry handling, persistence, and telemetry.
- 5. Restore canonical GitHub access via approved secure owner/App flow; verify `ibb142`, repository metadata, default branch, canonical HEAD, PRs, Actions, and jobs.
- 6. Obtain approved Render API access, inspect whether the service has an explicit `GITHUB_TOKEN`, and validate it through a read-only authenticated request to `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` without revealing the token.
- 7. Inventory local state; create recovery branch and backup tag; safely reconcile approved changes with canonical `main`, commit, push, review, and merge.
- 8. Verify full CI on the merged SHA only.
- 9. Bind/verify Render, deploy the exact merged SHA, and prove `/health`/`/version` parity.
- 10. Execute authorized production member/owner/AI-primary and platform release certification on the final SHA.

## Critical Context



- A valid fine-grained GitHub token for audit should be restricted to `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`, with at least Contents: Read and Actions: Read.
- Top-level local Git state previously observed:

  ```text
  recovery/canonical-main → 012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```

- `backend/api/ivx-members.ts` contains:

  - Reads `Authorization: Bearer ...`, loads Supabase URL/key from environment, creates a non-persistent client, and calls `client.auth.getUser(token)`.
- Existing OTP service uses `randomInt`, `scryptSync`, and `timingSafeEqual`; records store salted scrypt hashes rather than plaintext.
